features.earnings_yield: latest PIT annual net_income / market_cap; require net_income > 0 and market_cap > 0
features.fcf_yield: (latest PIT annual operating_cash_flow - latest PIT annual capex) / market_cap; require FCF > 0 and market_cap > 0
features.sales_yield: latest PIT annual revenue / market_cap; require revenue > 0 and market_cap > 0

fundamentals.selection: latest fiscal-year duration end, tag priority, latest eligible acceptance/accession

gates.P5: D10 excess and D10-D1 spread remain >0 in each of three extreme-removal audits
gates.P6: positive contribution concentration within 35%/75%/90% single/top5/top10 limits
gates.P7: base 10bp cost leaves D10 excess and D10-D1 spread >0

groups.deciles: deterministic rank then security_id tie break; D10 highest; array_split into ten near-equal groups; require >=20 rows/date

labels.excess: security price return - SPY price return
labels.missing: no backward/forward ticker substitution; label invalid
labels.price: unadjusted decision close to exact future-session close

rebalance.feature_cutoff: regular open at decision session; later filing unavailable
rebalance.last_primary: latest month-end with 63-session label no later than 2026-09-16

research_data.fundamental_store: existing H0 deterministic 40-CIK companyfacts plus C-E0 submissions; no new issuer selection

score.formula: equal-weight mean of available feature percentile ranks
score.rank: within-date ascending percentile; higher yield is more attractive

universe.label: LIMITED 2Y PREVALIDATION UNIVERSE; NOT SURVIVORSHIP-SAFE
universe.rule: intersection of 2024-10-25 dated active US CS on XNYS/XNAS/XASE with existing H0 40 CIK and observed local daily ticker
universe.single_class_policy: CIK with >1 eligible share class is MULTI_CLASS_UNRESOLVED and excluded from primary

verdict.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise, including any required gate UNMEASURABLE
verdict.UNPROMISING: P8 PASS and at most one of P1-P4 PASS
